blocks.html: As a command post you create and maintain the unit's RECON feed: create it, get the other CP users subscribed, then process incoming observations and send the processed markers back to the feed.

slides.title: Find the Data Sync tools
slides.html: In WinTAK's toolbar, the Home tab holds the Data Sync tools.

slides.title: Create a new feed
slides.html:
Operating as a command post, you create the feeds. Press New Feed.

At the command post, one user creates the feeds; the other CP users and the rest of the unit subscribe to them.

slides.title: Name the feed
slides.html:
Create the feed with:

  • Name: Recon
  • Group: tak_default
  • Default Role: Read Only

Change the default group to tak_default and the default role to Read Only.

slides.title: Feed created
slides.html: The feed is created and immediately shows as subscribed in the Data Sync menu for its creator. Other command-post users now subscribe to it (typically the RECON feed).

slides.title: Subscribe: download and stay synced
slides.html: In the feed's view, other CP users select Download and stay synced. The feed then appears in their Data Sync menu.

slides.title: Receive notifications
slides.html: WinTAK shows notifications like these when new observations arrive.

slides.title: Open the Notifications view
slides.html: Press the yellow flag symbol to open the Notifications view. It lists received notifications — process each one as below, then send it to the RECON feed.

slides.title: Open an observation
slides.html: Observations are opened and processed from the map. Open the observation you want to process.

slides.title: Open Marker Details
slides.html: From the circle menu, select the Marker Details icon (to the right of the trash can). The Marker Details view opens.

slides.title: Record your conclusion
slides.html:
When recording interpretations, keep your conclusion separate from the original description — use the notation HQ CONCLUSION: (your assessment).

Consider OPSEC: do not put operational enemy information here — use cover terms.

slides.title: Change the affiliation
slides.html: In Marker Details, change the observation type (unknown, friend, own, neutral) to match your conclusion by pressing Change Affiliation.

slides.title: Pick the new type
slides.html: After Change Affiliation, the Type menu opens — set the marker according to your conclusion. The marker then updates.

slides.title: Mark it as processed
slides.html: Add a notation to the marker's title — an underscore in front — to show the command post has processed it.

slides.title: Decide on immediate reporting
slides.html:
Determine whether the observation is an immediately reportable matter.

IMPORTANT: if it is, send a report using the prescribed messaging tools to the prescribed recipients — don't rely on the feed alone.

slides.title: Send the marker to the feed
slides.html: So the whole force sees the processed marker, press Send in the Marker Details menu.

slides.title: Choose the RECON feed
slides.html: The Send To menu opens on the right — send the marker to the RECON feed. Work through every processed observation the same way.
